text.12:71: They cried, coming toward them: What is it ye have lost?
text.12:82: Ask the township where we were, and the caravan with which we travelled hither. Lo! we speak the truth.
text.28:31: Throw down thy staff. And when he saw it writhing as it had been a demon, he turned to flee headlong, (and it was said unto him): O Moses! Draw nigh and fear not. Lo! thou art of those who are secure.
text.37:27: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
text.37:50: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
text.37:94: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.
text.51:29: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
text.52:25: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,
text.68:30: Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching.
